statement: No layer starts in mid-air: zero islands and zero hanging edges at the configured layer height
rationale: Supports are off (R3) and nothing inside the chamber can be reached, so one piece of one layer printed on air is a failed print or loose plastic in the airway. Zero is the only limit that means that. The fdm-print pack judges face angles and cannot see this fault: in the design panel a beak tip started in mid-air for 21 layers on a concept the pack passed. The count comes from a raster of every layer of the print file, not from a slicer.

mechanism.how: The print file rastered layer by layer at the configured layer height: a piece of a layer that touches nothing in the layer below is an island; new material more than one line width out that is not held at both ends is a hanging edge. Both are counted. Material held at both ends is a bridge and is allowed here.
